title: Earthquake of magnitude 3.2 hits Himachal Pradesh’s Chamba
text:
Earthquake of magnitude 3.2 hits Himachal Pradesh’s Chamba | Punjab Newsline Wednesday, 11 November 2026 Regional Excellence • Global Reach RSS Feed About Contact Trending National Punjab Haryana Himachal Chandigarh Other States Regional Portals Delhi NCR Uttar Pradesh Jammu & Kashmir Uttarakhand Political Business Opinion Films & TV Home Trending National Punjab Haryana Himachal Chandigarh Other States Regional Portals Delhi NCR Uttar Pradesh Jammu & Kashmir Uttarakhand Political Business Opinion Films & TV Videos Photos Trending Home Himachal Earthquake of magnitude 3.2 hits Himachal Pradesh’s Chamba
 Updated on: 6 Nov 2026 Punjab Newsline | Chamba 
 An earthquake of magnitude 3.2 struck Himachal Pradesh’s Chamba district on Friday morning, triggering panic among residents. The tremors were felt at around 6:59 am.
 According to the available information, the epicentre of the earthquake was located at a depth of approximately 15 kilometres below the Earth's surface.
 The early morning tremors briefly created panic among people. However, there were no immediate reports of any loss of life or property in the district.
 Chamba Deputy Commissioner Mukesh Repaswal said that no incident of damage or casualties had been reported due to the earthquake. He added that the administration was closely monitoring the situation.
 The situation in the district remains normal, and authorities are keeping a close watch on developments.
